_comment: Operator-maintained earnings calendar. Alpaca serves no earnings dates —
its corporate-actions endpoint covers dividends and splits only.
The earnings gate BLOCKS a single-name symbol that has no entry here. That is
deliberate: selling premium into an unknown event window is the exact mistake
this desk exists to avoid, so an unknown date abstains loudly rather than
waving the trade through. ETFs are exempt (see KNOWN_ETFS in data/calendar.py).
An entry is either a bare ISO date (treated as confirmed) or an object with
date / confidence / source. 'estimated' dates are forecasts from a reporting
pattern, not company announcements — they block exactly the same way, and the
gate says which kind it used so the reason string stays honest.
The gate applies EARNINGS_BLACKOUT_DAYS either side of the date, and also
blocks any report falling between today and the structure's expiry.
_verify_before_demo: Re-check every 'estimated' entry against the company IR page.

AAPL.source: forecast from historical fiscal-Q4 reporting pattern; not company-confirmed

NVDA.source: sources disagree (17 Nov vs 25 Nov); the earlier date is taken because it blocks the wider window
